'''Version 1.9.11''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on March 14th 2023.  It was 16.52 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*Mod Creative tab with wrong name (us)
*Tooltip number 1 weird text (us)
*Tooltip number 13 missing text (us)
*Missing lang name for block bush with variant "eye" (us)
*Missing lang name for block bush with variant "tooh" (us)
*[[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] versions despawn internal value not working
*Griefing task still working if "mobGriefing" gamerule is turned off
*[[Fear]] damage not working if effect amplifier is 0
*[[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated]] trying to melting if they are not supposed to do so
*Parasites breaking the following blocks:
**Portal
**Portal frame
**Portal Gateaway

*Crash:

====<u>General changes</u>====
*[[Parasite Biome#Biome Purifier|Purifier]] Blocks will now apply the rage effect to parasites within the scanning area
*[[Living Armor|Living]]/[[Sentient Armor|Sentient armor]] will now show you the current list of [[Adaptation System|adaptation]] and their values
*When an [[Evolution Phases|evolution phase]] is decreased, all local parasites will gain the [[rage]] effect
*[[Fear]] will now check Player flying capabilities to apply "Fear Air Damage Multiplier"
*The [[Commands|command]] "/srpevolution getphase" will now show you the current number of parasites around
*Updated [[Quench]] item texture
*Quench entity will now spawn particles
*Updated the following lang files:
**it_it
**lv_LV
**pt_br
**sv_se
**uk_ua
 
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*[[Stage IV Beckon|Beckon Stage IV]] will now stop other beckons from growing
*[[Kyphosis]] will now perform Wave attacks
*[[Primitive Longarms|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Longarms]] will now perform Wave attacks
*[[Incomplete Forms|Incomplete forms]] will not place [[Dispatcher Nidus|Nidus]] Blocks anymore
*If the [[Assimilated Enderman]] has the rage effect then the Assimilated Enderman will ignore tp cooldowns
*[[Seizer|Seziers]] will not remove Evolution Points when killed 
*[[Primitive Longarms|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Arachnida]] and [[Seizer]] will now dismount targets when pulling
*XP value for the Dispatcher tentacle is now 0
*XP value for the Seizer is now 0
*Added Sound Effects for the Adapted Arachnida
*Added Sound Effects for the [[Assimilated Cow]]
